imgDesc.text: In areas within the Temple of Space, after selecting an object within the temple, you can <color=#ffe04b>Hold and drag your Skill</color> to drag that object along a <color=#ffe04b>Spacelike Vector</color> . After dragging for a certain distance, <color=#ffe04b>maintain</color> that distance <color=#ffe04b>for a while</color> until the Spacelike Vector is <color=#ffe04b>fully charged</color> . <color=#ffe04b>Release the skill button</color> at this moment to trigger spatial folding and change the state of various objects.

You can control various objects in areas within the Temple of Space.
Some of these objects cannot be affected during Co-Op Mode.
<color=#ffe04b>Seize</color> certain objects within the Temple of Space to produce a variety of incredible effects at corresponding moments.
